thread:
jordan: Heads-up — deploy-bot queued a canary for 1.8.2 after the cherry-pick to release-1.8. Need to decide auto-patch bump behavior before we let it tag and publish notes.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled canary -> v1.8.2 (sha: abcdef123) by jordan. Trigger: cherry-pick PR #421. /deploy canary

maria: Do we want deploy-bot to auto-increment patch on cherry-picked bugfixes? Currently we require a manual bump in versions.json and a human-created tag.

samir: My preference: auto-increment the patch only for PRs labeled `bugfix` (not infra or docs). Also require that the PR title contains the backport target branch. Auto-bump should also generate a draft release with collected PR descriptions.

liz: Slight worry: Dedicated customers pin container tags. If deploy-bot auto-tags, ops needs an immutable manifest we can reference. Otherwise image pinning will miss new tags.

ben: A compromise: use build metadata for CI-only bumps so internal CI can generate `v1.8.2+ci.123` for artifacts, but keep the canonical semver tag `v1.8.2` for releases. That way precedence isn't affected and pins can still reference `v1.8.2`.

maria: I like keeping semver pure. But note: npm/git semantics treat `+build` as metadata and won't change precedence — fine. For GitHub releases we still push `v1.8.2` tag.

samir: Concrete proposal to record:
- deploy-bot auto-bumps patch in `versions.json` for PRs with label `bugfix` and with a backport marker.
- deploy-bot creates a draft GitHub release populated from merged PR bodies and linked issues.
- deploy-bot tags `v<semver>` and optionally pushes CI-only metadata tags like `v<semver>+ci.<build>`.
- opt-out label: `no-auto-bump` to prevent automatic tagging for a given PR.

jordan: Opt-out label seems safe. Also we need a rollback automation: if canary health fails we should auto-rollback the canary and open a rollback PR to main that reverts the cherry-pick commit.

liz: For Dedicated, we'll add a `release-manifest.yaml` per release that infra reads. Example entry:```
- version: v1.8.2
  images:
    api: registry.redwood/infra/api:v1.8.2
    runtime: registry.redwood/infer/runtime:v1.8.2
```
That keeps pinned consumers consistent.

ben: Also add a webhook to notify #eng-oncall and #sales 15m before canary rolls (so support can prep) and immediate alerts on canary failure. Include `change-window` metadata in release notes.

maria: Can we add a quick `semver-oracle` check in CI that runs on the release branch to sanity-check for accidental breaking changes (e.g., removed public APIs)? If the check flags risk, block auto-bump and require manual review.

samir: I'll wire the oracle and the rollback script. Rollback script will be `scripts/rollback_canary.sh` and invoked by deploy-bot on healthcheck failure. It will revert the cherry-pick and annotate the PR.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: policy updated — `auto-patch` enabled for label `bugfix`; opt-out label: `no-auto-bump`. Draft release created: https://github.com/redwood/releases/draft/1.8.2 (notes auto-collected).

jordan: :thumbsup: I'll update docs in `docs/releases.md` with the new flow (auto-bump rules, opt-out label, dedicated release-manifest), and add the `no-auto-bump` label to the repo. Patching behavior goes live tomorrow 09:00 UTC.

samir: I'll add `scripts/rollback_canary.sh` and the `semver-oracle` CI check. Will @deploy-bot tie this into the canary health hook?

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: yes — rollback hook wired. If canary fails, deploy-bot will:
1) revert backport commit on release branch
2) untag pushed release tag on remote (and create a `revert-tag` note)
3) open PR to main with revert and ping @eng-releases

liz: Great — will coordinate with Dedicated team to consume `release-manifest.yaml`. We should also publish a short release note template to populate the GitHub draft.

jordan: OK — consensus reached. Summary I'll add to docs: `auto-patch` = on for labelled bugfix backports, opt-out label available, deploy-bot drafts releases + tags, rollback automation on canary failure, Dedicated uses release manifest. Live 09:00 UTC tomorrow.

ben: Nice. Small sample changelog line for auto-generated notes: `- fix(api): prevent N+1 in /predict (cherry-picked from #414)`

maria: Thanks all — will review the docs PR once it's up.

jordan: Closing loop, thanks everyone.
